# Digital Health & AI in Medicine

> Digital health and AI in medicine: milestones, benchmarks and original studies.

Published by Gilles Penning (https://gillespenning.com/). Last evidence review: 2026-11-21. Last site update: 2026-11-22.

## Key pages
- [AI in Medicine Monitor](https://ai.gillespenning.com/): Benchmarks, milestones and original studies across medical knowledge, clinical assistance and autonomous workflows (EN/DE).
- [Chronological News](https://ai.gillespenning.com/news/): Posts and articles on AI, medicine and healthcare.
- [RSS Feed](https://ai.gillespenning.com/rss.xml): Chronological news feed.
- [Portable Monitor Data](https://ai.gillespenning.com/data/monitor-data.json): Structured JSON dataset of benchmarks, studies, sources and evidence classifications.
- [Evidence Standard](https://ai.gillespenning.com/MONITOR_STANDARD.md): Editorial, frontier and source-verification rules.

## Companion projects
- [AI in Medicine Wimmelbook (EN)](https://wimmelbild.gillespenning.com/en/): Interactive illustrated exploration of AI in medicine.
- [KI-Wimmelbild (DE)](https://wimmelbild.gillespenning.com/): Interaktives Wimmelbild zu KI in der Medizin.
- [Portfolio](https://gillespenning.com/): Gilles Penning.
